levelTitle: Level 0 - Teen Startup / Nivel 0 - Inicio adolescente
objective: Construir una base Pre-A1 con identidad personal, escuela, objetos, gustos y comunicación inmediata.

classes.title: Class 1: Hello & Introductions / Clase 1: Hello & Introductions
classes.description: A fun and interactive class for teens.
classes.objective: Master the topic of Hello & Introductions.

sec2Slides.title: Saying Hello & Asking Names 👋 / Saludos y Nombres
content: Formal: Hello! / Good morning! / Nice to meet you!
Informal: Hey! / What's up? / How's it going?
Feelings: I'm great! / I'm fine, thanks / Not bad, you?

sec2Slides.title: The Introduction Formula 📝 / Fórmula de Presentación
content: Formula: [Greeting] + [I'm Name] + [Nice to meet you] + [How are you?]
Example 1: 'Hey! I'm Alex. Nice to meet you! How are you today?'
Example 2: 'Good morning! My name is Sofia. I'm great, and you?'

sec2Slides.title: Quick Check: Say Hi! 🎯 / Mini Reto
content: Tell the teacher out loud:
1. Greet the teacher politely.
2. State your name and how you feel today!

classes.sec3Title: 3. Practice & Concept Checking / 3. Práctica y Concept Checking

classes.title: Class 2: Numbers, Ages & Birthdays / Clase 2: Numbers, Ages & Birthdays
classes.description: A fun and interactive class for teens.
classes.objective: Master the topic of Numbers, Ages & Birthdays.
sec1Goal: ✔️ Ask and answer 'How old are you?'.
✔️ Talk about your birthday and months.

sec2Slides.title: Numbers 1-31 & Birthday Months 🎂 / Números y Meses
content: Numbers 1-10: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten
Numbers 11-20: eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen, fifteen, twenty...
Months: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December

sec2Slides.title: The Age & Birthday Formula 📅 / Fórmula de Edad y Cumpleaños
sec2Slides.description: Age with Verb To Be and Months with IN
content: Age Formula: I am + [Number] + years old. (Never say 'I have 14 years')
Birthday Formula: My birthday is IN + [Month].
Example: 'I am 14 years old and my birthday is in October.'

sec2Slides.title: Quick Check: Birthday Card 🎯 / Mini Reto
content: Complete and say out loud to the teacher:
'I am ________ years old and my birthday is in ________.'

classes.sec3Title: 3. Practice & Concept Checking / 3. Práctica y Concept Checking

classes.title: Class 3: My Body & Actions / Clase 3: My Body & Actions
classes.description: A fun and interactive class for teens.
classes.objective: Master the topic of My Body & Actions.

sec2Slides.title: Body Parts & Action Verbs 💪 / Partes del Cuerpo y Acciones
content: Body: Head, arms, legs, hands, feet, eyes, ears
Actions: Run fast, jump high, dance, swim, play soccer, skate
Which action do you do every week?

sec2Slides.title: The Ability Formula: CAN vs CAN'T ⚡ / Fórmula de Habilidades
sec2Slides.description: Expressing What You Can and Cannot Do
content: Positive (+): I CAN + [Verb] -> 'I can skate very well.'
Negative (-): I CAN'T + [Verb] -> 'I can't swim yet.'
Contrast: 'I can play soccer, but I can't dance hip-hop.'

sec2Slides.title: Quick Check: Talent Show 🎯 / Mini Reto
content: Tell the teacher:
1. Name 2 cool things you CAN do.
2. Name 1 action you CAN'T do yet!

classes.sec3Title: 3. Practice & Concept Checking / 3. Práctica y Concept Checking

classes.title: Class 4: My Favorite Gadgets & Tech / Clase 4: My Favorite Gadgets & Tech
classes.description: A fun and interactive class for teens.
classes.objective: Master the topic of My Favorite Gadgets & Tech.

sec2Slides.title: Gadgets, Tech & Adjectives 📱🎧 / Tecnología y Adjetivos
content: Devices: Smartphone, laptop, headphones, smartwatch, gaming console, tablet
Adjectives: Fast, cool, useful, modern, portable, expensive
What is your #1 favorite device?

sec2Slides.title: The Tech Possession Formula 💻 / Fórmula de Posesión
content: I / You / We / They -> HAVE | He / She / It -> HAS
Formula: Subject + have/has + a/an + [Adjective] + [Device]
Example: 'I have wireless headphones and they are super useful for music.'

sec2Slides.title: Quick Check: Favorite Device 🎯 / Mini Reto
content: Tell the teacher:
'I have a ________ and it is very ________.'
What do you use it for most?

classes.sec3Title: 3. Practice & Concept Checking / 3. Práctica y Concept Checking

classes.title: Class 5: Food Likes, Dislikes & Flavors / Clase 5: Gustos, disgustos y sabores
classes.description: Introducir vocabulario y preferencias; los pedidos completos se reservan para Basic 1.
classes.objective: Usar like/don’t like, Do you like...? y adjetivos simples de sabor.
sec1Goal: Ask and answer Do you like...?

sec2Slides.title: Snacks, Drinks & Flavors 🍕🥤 / Snacks y Sabores
content: Snacks: Pizza, burger, popcorn, nachos, cookies, fruit salad
Drinks: Lemonade, bubble tea, iced tea, soda, water, smoothie
Flavors: Sweet (dulce), salty (salado), spicy (picante), delicious

sec2Slides.title: The Preference Formula: LIKE & BECAUSE 😋 / Fórmula de Gustos
content: Like (+): I like / I love [Food] because it is [Flavor].
Dislike (-): I don't like [Food] because it is too sweet / salty.
Example: 'I love bubble tea because it is cold and sweet!'

sec2Slides.title: Quick Check: Snack Attack 🎯 / Mini Reto
content: Tell the teacher:
1. What is your #1 favorite snack and why?
2. One food or drink you really dislike!

classes.sec3Title: 3. Practice & Concept Checking / 3. Práctica y Concept Checking

classes.title: Class 6: Shapes & Patterns / Clase 6: Shapes & Patterns
classes.description: A fun and interactive class for teens.
classes.objective: Master the topic of Shapes & Patterns.

sec2Slides.title: Shapes, Colors & Patterns 📐🎨 / Formas y Diseños
content: Shapes: Circle, square, triangle, rectangle, star
Patterns: Striped (rayas), dotted (puntos), plain (liso), checkered (cuadros)
Colors: Dark blue, light green, neon pink, matte black

sec2Slides.title: The Object Description Formula 🔍 / Fórmula de Descripción
content: Formula: It is a + [Color] + [Pattern/Shape] + [Object].
Example 1: 'My hoodie is dark blue and striped.'
Example 2: 'My notebook is a neon pink rectangle.'

sec2Slides.title: Quick Check: Describe an Item 🎯 / Mini Reto
content: Look around your room or desk right now:
'It is a (color) and (shape/style) ________.'
Say your sentence out loud to the teacher!

classes.title: Class 7: School Subjects & Supplies / Clase 7: School Subjects & Supplies
classes.description: A fun and interactive class for teens.
classes.objective: Master the topic of School Subjects & Supplies.

sec2Slides.title: School Subjects & Backpack Gear 🎒📚 / Materias y Útiles
content: Subjects: Math, Science, English, History, Art, P.E. (Physical Education)
Supplies: Backpack, notebook, pencil case, pens, ruler, scissors, calculator
Which school subject is your absolute favorite?

sec2Slides.title: The Backpack Formula: THERE IS / THERE ARE 🎒 / Fórmula de Existencia
content: Singular (1): In my backpack, THERE IS a calculator and a notebook.
Plural (2+): In my backpack, THERE ARE three pens and two highlighters.
Example: 'In my pencil case, there is an eraser and there are two markers.'

sec2Slides.title: Quick Check: Backpack Scan 🎯 / Mini Reto
content: Tell the teacher:
1. What is your favorite school subject?
2. Name 2 items in your bag using 'There is...' and 'There are...'

classes.title: Class 8: Pets & Animal Friends / Clase 8: Pets & Animal Friends
classes.description: A fun and interactive class for teens.
classes.objective: Master the topic of Pets & Animal Friends.

sec2Slides.title: Pets & Animal Friends 🐶🐱 / Mascotas y Animales
content: Pets: Dog, cat, parrot, hamster, rabbit, turtle, fish
Wild Animals: Lion, dolphin, eagle, tiger, monkey
Adjectives: Playful, smart, fast, furry, cute, loyal

sec2Slides.title: The Animal Spotlight Formula 🐾 / Fórmula de Animales
content: Formula: My favorite animal is the [Animal] because it is [Adjective] and can [Action].
Example 1: 'My dog is very playful and he can fetch the ball.'
Example 2: 'Dolphins are smart and can swim very fast in the ocean.'

sec2Slides.title: Quick Check: Animal Kingdom 🎯 / Mini Reto
content: Tell the teacher:
'My favorite animal is the ________ because it is ________ and can ________.'

classes.title: Class 9: My Hobbies & Free Time / Clase 9: My Hobbies & Free Time
classes.description: A fun and interactive class for teens.
classes.objective: Master the topic of My Hobbies & Free Time.

sec2Slides.title: Hobbies & Free Time Activities 🎮🎨 / Pasatiempos
content: Gaming, drawing, playing guitar, listening to music, watching anime
Skateboarding, photography, baking, coding, dancing TikTok dances
Time: In my free time / On weekends / After school

sec2Slides.title: The Hobby Expression Formula 🎧 / Fórmula de Hobbies
content: Formula: In my free time, I love/enjoy + [Verb-ing] because it is [Reason].
Example 1: 'In my free time, I really enjoy playing online games with friends.'
Example 2: 'On weekends, I prefer listening to music because it relaxes me.'

sec2Slides.title: Quick Check: Hobby Spotlight 🎯 / Mini Reto
content: Tell the teacher:
'In my free time, I really enjoy ________ because it is ________.'

classes.title: Class 10: Family, Possessives & People / Clase 10: Familia, posesivos y personas
classes.description: Construir la base de familia, he/she y my/his/her.
classes.objective: Identificar relaciones y describir una persona mediante posesivos y adjetivos básicos.

sec2Slides.title: Family Members & Traits 🏠👥 / Familia y Rasgos
content: Parents: Mother (Mom), Father (Dad) | Siblings: Brother, Sister
Extended: Grandmother, Grandfather, Uncle, Aunt, Cousin
Traits: Kind, funny, creative, hardworking, tall, cheerful

sec2Slides.title: The Family Intro Formula: POSSESSIVES 🔑 / Fórmula de Familia
content: Formula: This is my [Relative]. (His/Her) name is [Name] and (he/she) is [Trait].
Example 1: 'This is my sister. Her name is Sofia and she is very creative.'
Example 2: 'This is my brother. His name is Leo and he loves soccer.'

sec2Slides.title: Quick Check: Family Intro 🎯 / Mini Reto
content: Introduce 1 family member to the teacher:
'This is my ________. (His/Her) name is ________ and (he/she) is ________.'

classes.title: Class 11: Alfabeto, deletreo and usernames / Clase 11: Alfabeto, deletreo y usernames
classes.description: A fun and interactive class for teens.
classes.objective: Master the topic of Alfabeto, deletreo y usernames.

sec2Slides.title: Alphabet, Vowels & Tricky Letters 🅰️🗣️ / El Alfabeto
content: Vowels: A /ei/, E /i:/, I /ai/, O /ou/, U /ju:/
Tricky Letters: G /dʒi:/ vs J /dʒei/ | H /eitʃ/ | R /ɑ:r/ | W /dʌbəl ju:/ | Y /wai/ | Z /zi:/
Symbols: @ = 'at' | _ = 'underscore' | . = 'dot'

sec2Slides.title: The Spelling & Handle Formula 📱 / Fórmula de Deletreo
sec2Slides.description: How to Spell Names and Handles
content: Name Spelling: 'My name is ALEX -> A - L - E - X.'
Username Formula: 'My handle is @alex_gamer -> alex underscore gamer at instagram dot com.'
Question: 'How do you spell your last name, please?'

sec2Slides.title: Quick Check: Spell It Out! 🎯 / Mini Reto
content: Spell your first name letter by letter to the teacher:
Example: 'My name is LUCAS -> L - U - C - A - S'

classes.title: Class 12: My Teen Profile / Clase 12: Mi perfil adolescente
classes.description: Integrar saludo, edad, ciudad, curso y gustos en un perfil conectado.
classes.objective: Crear una presentación completa sin volver a enseñar los saludos de la clase 1.

sec2Slides.title: Personal Profile & Goals 🪪🌟 / Perfil Personal
content: Facts: Name, Age (I am 14), City & Country (I live in Medellin), Grade (9th grade)
Goals: I want to learn English to travel / chat with gamers / study abroad
Connectors: Use 'AND' for extra facts, 'BUT' for contrasts

sec2Slides.title: The Complete Bio Formula 🗣️ / Fórmula de Biografía
content: Formula: Hi! I'm [Name], [Age] years old from [City]. I love [Hobby] and I want to [Goal]!
Example: 'Hi! I'm Mateo, 15 years old from Cali. I love video games and I want to travel the world!'

sec2Slides.title: Quick Check: 20-Second Bio 🎯 / Mini Reto
content: Deliver your bio to the teacher in 3 complete sentences:
1. Name, age, city.
2. Favorite hobby.
3. Your goal in English!

classes.title: Class 13: Clothes, estilo personal and apariencia / Clase 13: Ropa, estilo personal y apariencia
classes.description: A fun and interactive class for teens.
classes.objective: Master the topic of Ropa, estilo personal y apariencia.

sec2Slides.title: Clothes, Sneakers & Style 👖👟 / Ropa y Calzado
content: Clothes: Hoodie, jacket, t-shirt, jeans, cargo pants, shorts, cap, sunglasses
Shoes & Bags: Sneakers, boots, backpack
Appearance: Tall, short, curly hair, straight hair, dark eyes

sec2Slides.title: The Outfit Formula: PRESENT CONTINUOUS 🧥 / Fórmula de Outfit
content: Formula: Today I am wearing a [Color/Item] with [Color/Item] and [Shoes].
Example 1: 'Today I am wearing an oversized black hoodie with blue jeans and white sneakers.'
Example 2: 'She is wearing a green jacket, dark sunglasses, and cool boots.'

sec2Slides.title: Quick Check: Outfit Scanner 🎯 / Mini Reto
content: Look down at your clothes right now:
'Today I am wearing a ________ and ________.'
Tell the teacher your outfit!

classes.title: Class 14: Lost & Found at School / Clase 14: Objetos perdidos en la escuela
classes.description: Aplicar objetos escolares conocidos a ubicación, preguntas y resolución de un problema.
classes.objective: Preguntar dónde está un objeto y describir su ubicación con preposiciones.
sec1Goal: Use location prepositions to solve the case.

sec2Slides.title: Classroom Spaces, Items & Prepositions 🪑🏫 / El Salón de Clases
content: Objects: Desk, chair, whiteboard, projector, clock, door, laptop, backpack
Prepositions of Place: In, on, under, next to, behind, in front of
Commands: Open your book, take notes, raise your hand

sec2Slides.title: The Classroom Location Formula 📍 / Fórmula de Ubicación
content: Formula: The [Object] is [Preposition] the [Location].
Example 1: 'The notebook is ON the desk next to the laptop.'
Example 2: 'The backpack is UNDER the chair behind Sofia.'

sec2Slides.title: Quick Check: Classroom Detective 🎯 / Mini Reto
content: Where is your pen or phone right now?
'My (pen/phone) is (on/under/next to) the ________.'
Say it out loud to the teacher!

classes.title: Class 15: Rutina diaria básica / Clase 15: Rutina diaria básica
classes.description: A fun and interactive class for teens.
classes.objective: Master the topic of Rutina diaria básica.

sec2Slides.title: Daily Routine & Telling Time 🌅⌚ / Rutina y Horas
content: Routine Verbs: Wake up, take a shower, have breakfast, go to school, do homework, go to bed
Telling Time: 7:00 (seven o'clock) | 7:15 (a quarter past seven) | 7:30 (half past seven) | 7:45 (a quarter to eight)
Prepositions: AT + hour (at 6:30 AM) | IN + part of day (in the morning, in the evening)

sec2Slides.title: The Daily Routine Formula 🔄 / Fórmula de Rutina
sec2Slides.description: Action + AT Time + IN Part of Day
content: Formula: I [Routine Action] at [Time] [Part of Day].
Example 1: 'I wake up at 6:30 AM in the morning.'
Example 2: 'I do my homework at 4:00 PM in the afternoon.'

sec2Slides.title: Quick Check: Daily Clock 🎯 / Mini Reto
content: Tell the teacher:
1. What time do you wake up on school days?
2. What time do you go to sleep?

classes.objective: Review and master all vocabulary and grammar from Level 0.
sec1Goal: ✔️ Play games and win the final challenge!

sec2Slides.title: Level 0 Grand Review: Personal Bio & Skills 🌟 / Gran Repaso
content: Bio: Greetings, name, age (I am 15), birthday month, city
Abilities & Tech: I can skate (can/can't), I have a laptop (have/has)
Routine & Style: Today I am wearing a hoodie, I wake up at 7:00 AM

sec2Slides.title: The Startup Capstone Formula 🎓 / Fórmula Final
sec2Slides.description: Triad of Fluency for Startup Graduation
content: 1. Introduce yourself & how you feel.
2. Share 1 thing you have and 1 thing you can do.
3. State your favorite hobby and routine time.
Example: 'Hi! I'm Leo, 15. I have headphones, I can play soccer, and I love gaming!'

sec2Slides.title: Quick Check: Grand Startup Pitch 🎯 / Gran Reto
content: Deliver your 30-second Level 0 English pitch to the teacher!
Show everything you learned in Level 0!

levelTitle: Level 1 - Teen Explorer / Nivel 1 - Explorador adolescente
objective: Ampliar la base hacia perfiles personales, decisiones saludables, planes, compras, tecnología y comunicación práctica.

classes.title: Class 1: People Profiles, Friendship & Feelings / Clase 1: Perfiles, amistad y emociones
classes.description: Extender la familia conocida hacia amistades, personalidad, apariencia y estados emocionales.
classes.objective: Crear perfiles de personas usando this/these, have/has, feelings y personality adjectives.
sec1Goal: Use have/has for features and interests.

sec2Slides.title: People in Your Circle / Personas cercanas
content: Friend, classmate, teammate, neighbor, cousin
This is my classmate, Eva.
These are my teammates.

sec2Slides.title: Personality Words / Personalidad
content: Friendly, quiet, funny, creative, helpful
Leo is creative and helpful.
Use be for personality and feelings.

sec2Slides.title: Feelings Can Change / Emociones
content: Excited, worried, tired, calm, proud
My friend is worried about the test.
Ask: How does he or she feel?

classes.sec3Title: 3. Practice & Concept Checking / 3. Práctica y comprensión
sec4Roleplay: Student A: Introduce two people and say how they feel.
Student B: Ask Who is this? and How does he/she feel?
Mission: Use this is, have/has, and two feeling words.

classes.title: Class 2: Healthy Habits, Food & Energy / Clase 2: Hábitos saludables, comida y energía
classes.description: Ampliar alimentos conocidos hacia decisiones de salud sin repetir pedidos de cafetería.
classes.objective: Relacionar comida, agua, sueño y movimiento con energía usando because.
sec1Goal: Compare a helpful and unhelpful habit.

sec2Slides.title: Food for Energy / Comida y energía
content: Fruit, vegetables, protein, grains
Different foods help the body in different ways.
Build a meal, not a restaurant order.

sec2Slides.title: Water and Drinks / Agua y bebidas
content: Water helps you stay focused.
Too much soda can reduce steady energy.
I choose water because I have practice.

sec2Slides.title: Sleep and Movement / Sueño y movimiento
content: Sleep, walk, stretch, exercise
Healthy energy is not only about food.
I sleep eight hours on school nights.

classes.sec3Title: 3. Practice & Concept Checking / 3. Práctica y comprensión
sec4Roleplay: Student A: Take the order and offer two drinks.
Student B: Order a meal and choose the healthier drink.
Mission: Use please, I would like, and because.

classes.title: Class 3: Weather Forecast & What to Bring / Clase 3: Pronóstico y qué llevar
classes.description: Usar ropa conocida para interpretar el clima y preparar un plan.
classes.objective: Describir el pronóstico y decidir qué usar o llevar según las condiciones.
sec1Goal: Choose what to wear or bring.

sec2Slides.title: Read the Forecast / Leer el pronóstico
content: Sunny, cloudy, rainy, windy, hot, cold
It will be rainy this afternoon.
Focus on conditions and decisions, not a clothing list.

sec2Slides.title: Temperature and Conditions / Temperatura
content: It is 12 degrees and windy.
The morning is cool, but the afternoon is warm.
Use and/but to connect conditions.

sec2Slides.title: What Do You Need? / ¿Qué necesitas?
content: You need an umbrella.
Bring water and a cap.
Wear comfortable shoes.

classes.sec3Title: 3. Practice & Concept Checking / 3. Práctica y comprensión
sec4Roleplay: Student A: Give today’s weather forecast.
Student B: Recommend three clothing items.
Mission: Describe the final outfit with be + wearing and because.

classes.title: Class 4: Nature, Locations & Park Rules / Clase 4: Naturaleza, ubicación y reglas del parque
classes.description: Describir un espacio natural y cuidarlo mediante instrucciones claras.
classes.objective: Usar there is/are, preposiciones e imperativos para describir y proteger un parque.

sec2Slides.title: Outdoor Places / Lugares al aire libre
content: Park, trail, lake, garden, playground
There is a lake near the trail.
There are trees around the playground.

sec2Slides.title: Locate Nature / Ubicar la naturaleza
content: next to, behind, between, across from
The garden is behind the café.
Two benches are next to the lake.

sec2Slides.title: Describe What You See / Describir
content: There is + singular or uncountable
There are + plural
Add color, size, or condition.

classes.sec3Title: 3. Practice & Concept Checking / 3. Práctica y comprensión
sec4Roleplay: Student A: Ask what the park has and what you can do.
Student B: Describe three places and two activities.
Mission: Include there is/are and one responsible suggestion.

classes.title: Class 5: Weekend Intentions & Simple Plans / Clase 5: Intenciones y planes de fin de semana
classes.description: Planear con want to, would like to y going to sin adelantar el contraste completo con will.
classes.objective: Expresar una intención y organizar un plan sencillo con día, hora y lugar.
sec1Goal: Use going to for one planned action.
Add a day, time, and place.

sec2Slides.title: Wants and Interests / Deseos e intereses
content: I want to relax this weekend.
I would like to visit the new park.
Use these forms before confirming a plan.

sec2Slides.title: Going To for an Intention / Intención
content: I am going to study Saturday morning.
We are going to play soccer.
be + going to + base verb

sec2Slides.title: Add Plan Details / Añadir detalles
content: Day: on Saturday
Time: at three o’clock
Place: at the community center

classes.sec3Title: 3. Practice & Concept Checking / 3. Práctica y comprensión
sec4Roleplay: Student A: Suggest two planned activities.
Student B: Ask about time and place.
Mission: Use going to twice; then react to a weather surprise with will.

classes.title: Class 6: Invitations—Accepting & Declining / Clase 6: Invitaciones—aceptar y rechazar
classes.description: Invite someone, respond politely, give a reason, and suggest another time.
classes.objective: Make invitations and accept or decline them politely with a clear follow-up.
sec1Goal: ✔️ Give a reason or suggest another time.

sec2Slides.title: Make an Invitation 💌 / Invitar
content: Would you like to watch a movie?
Do you want to play soccer?
Yes, I would love to!

sec2Slides.title: Give a Reason 💬 / Dar una razón
content: I have soccer practice.
I need to study for a test.
How about Sunday?

sec2Slides.title: Suggest Another Time 📅
content: How about Sunday?
Maybe another day.
Are you free tomorrow?

classes.sec3Title: 3. Practice & Concept Checking / 3. Práctica y comprensión
sec4Roleplay: Student A: Invite your partner to an activity.
Student B: Decline with a reason and suggest another time.
Mission: Agree on the final day, time, and place.

classes.title: Class 7: Clothing Store - Prices, Sizes & Payment / Clase 7: Tienda de ropa - Precios, tallas y pago
classes.description: Convertir vocabulario de ropa en una interacción de compra completa.
classes.objective: Preguntar precio, talla y color, probar una opción y pagar con cortesía.

sec2Slides.title: Clothes in a Store 👕
content: Hoodie, T-shirt, jeans, jacket
Sneakers, boots, cap
How much is this hoodie?

sec2Slides.title: Choose an Item ✅
content: I would like this jacket.
These sneakers are comfortable.
I will take it.

sec2Slides.title: Pay Politely 💳
content: I will take it.
Can I pay by card?
Thank you. Have a nice day!

classes.sec3Title: 3. Practice & Concept Checking / 3. Práctica y comprensión
sec4Roleplay: Student A: You are the shop assistant; offer colors and sizes.
Student B: Ask the price, try an option, and choose one item.
Mission: Finish with a payment question and a polite goodbye.

classes.title: Class 8: Café Ordering & Menu Questions / Clase 8: Pedidos y preguntas de menú
classes.description: Reservar esta clase como la interacción principal de comida y servicio.
classes.objective: Leer opciones, pedir, aclarar y pagar en una cafetería.
sec1Goal: Ask one option or payment question.

sec2Slides.title: Café Food 🥪 / Comida de cafetería
content: Sandwich, burger, pizza slice
Chips, cookies, fruit, salad
Item = what you can order

sec2Slides.title: Ask About Options ❓
content: What drinks do you have?
Does it come with fries?
I prefer juice to soda.

sec2Slides.title: Preferences and Payment 💳
content: I prefer juice to soda.

sec2Slides.title: Past Modals of Deduction: Must have, Could have, Can't have 🕵️⏳ / Deducción en Pasado
content: MUST HAVE + Participle (95% sure it happened): 'She must have forgotten her phone at school.'
COULD / MIGHT HAVE (50% possibility): 'They might have missed the 5:00 PM train.'
CAN'T HAVE (99% impossible): 'He can't have broken the window—he was with us all afternoon.'
Clue: The window was open and the prize trophy was missing.

sec2Slides.title: The Forensic Investigation Formula ⚖️ / Fórmula Forense
content: Formula: Given that [Past Evidence], the suspect MUST/CAN'T HAVE [Past Action] because [Reason].
Example: 'Given that the floor was dry, it CAN'T HAVE rained last night.'
Deduction: 'It CAN'T HAVE been an accident because the lock was forced.'

sec2Slides.title: The Complete Conditional Spectrum 🌈⚡ / Síntesis Condicional

First: Real future possibilities ('If it's sunny tomorrow, we will skate.')
Second: Imaginary hypotheses ('If I were invisible, I could explore anywhere.')
AS LONG AS / PROVIDED THAT = Only if ('You can join the esports team as long as you maintain your grades.')

content: Formula: 'Provided that we [Condition], we will [Victory Outcome] as long as [Team Rule].'

AS LONG AS / PROVIDED THAT = Only if ('You can join the esports team as long as you maintain your grades.')
